title: Pão de queijo de liquidificador
creator: pablofigueiredoc
steps: Blend the water, oil, eggs and salt until smooth.
Add the polvilho and cheese and blend again until it forms a single batter.
Pour the runny batter into a greased muffin tin.
Bake in a preheated oven at 180 °C until puffed and golden. It looks like it won't work at first, then rises suddenly.
notes: The creator suggests adding extra cheese on top and microwaving briefly to melt it.
